completion_promises.criterion_text: Another student's fetch of an announced chunk is refused as forbidden; a fetch of the same chunk through the owner's *other* session is refused as not found (session-scoped references)

completion_promises.criterion_text: Long-answer chunk availability: with a fake clock and a many-chunk answer, every announced chunk is still retrievable when fetched in announced order (ASSUM-010, hermetic)
completion_promises.evidence: Created test_many_chunk_answer_all_chunks_remain_available with fake clock using unittest.mock.patch to control time.time. Test verifies ASSUM-010 eviction policy hermetically by advancing fake clock between chunk fetches and confirming all chunks remain available. Uses ChunkStore with configurable TTL and tests orderly playback scenario.

Test validates response structure per binding §2 Rev 1 (transcript, tutor_response, audio fields), verifies audio_ref format per binding §4 Rev 1 (seq, chunk_id, url fields), and confirms chunks are fetchable. completion_promises.criterion_text: All tests hermetic (fake AudioClient/ChunkStore/clock, no real STT/TTS) and pass with `uv run pytest <new test paths> -x -q`
completion_promises.evidence: All tests use fake AudioClient (no real STT/TTS), fake ChunkStore, and fake clock (via patch). Tests are hermetic.
